race.description: Barmah Park Restaurant & Cellar Door Mdn Plate
race.comment: SCOOT (12) is a very well bred filly on debut for the Freedman yard. By Street Boss out of G1 winning mare Flit, she's jumped out well as a half sister to the smart Cabriole. Blake Shinn booked from the inside gate, she should take some beating. MO (9) didn't fire on debut here but was in the market. He can improve sharply this time for strong connections. MODEL GIGI (11) wasn't beaten far first up at Pakenham Synthetic. To 1200m suits now and she'll take some running down. Wary of  REGAL HARRY (10) on debut for the Douglas yard, he's also entered in the Red Anchor Stakes on Saturday so clearly there's an opinion of him.
